body:
### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

When doing design prep for Stand alone Nexus operations we found that lots of classes will have name collisions with the existing workflow based Nexus Operation classes.

### Describe the solution you'd like

Rename the workflow based Nexus Operation classes pre-emtively to avoid any conflict in the future. The current thought is to add `workflow` so `NexusClient` becomes `NexusWorkflowClient`

title: [Feature Request] Rename Nexus Operation classes used in a workflow in preparation for Stand alone Nexus operations
